recipes.name: Classic Avocado Toast
recipes.instructions: Toast the bread. Mash avocado with length juice. Spread and sprinkle with flakes.

recipes.name: Quinoa Salad Bowl
recipes.instructions: Cook quinoa. Chop vegetables. Toss everything with olive oil and lemon.

recipes.name: Spicy Garlic Shrimp
recipes.instructions: Sauté garlic in oil. Add shrimp until pink. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Berry Smoothie
recipes.instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.instructions: Slowly add broth to rice while stirring. Mix in sautéed mushrooms and cheese.

recipes.name: Caprese Skewers
recipes.instructions: Thread ingredients onto small skewers. Drizzle with balsamic.

recipes.name: Chickpea Curry
recipes.instructions: Simmer chickpeas in coconut milk and spices. Stir in spinach at the end.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
recipes.instructions: Layer yogurt, granola, and berries in a glass. Top with nuts.

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
recipes.instructions: Brown the beef with spices. Fill shells and add toppings.

recipes.name: Pesto Pasta
recipes.instructions: Boil pasta. Drain and mix with pesto. Top with nuts and tomatoes.

recipes.name: Banana Pancakes
recipes.instructions: Mash bananas and mix with eggs. Fry small circles until golden.

recipes.name: Tomato Basil Soup
recipes.instructions: Sauté aromatics, add tomatoes, simmer, and blend until creamy.

recipes.name: Honey Glazed Salmon
recipes.instructions: Sear salmon skin-side down. Pour glaze over and finish in oven.

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
recipes.instructions: Slice tomatoes and cheese. Alternate on a plate and drizzle oil.

recipes.name: Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.instructions: Flash-fry chicken. Add veggies and sauce. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Ceviche Peruano
recipes.instructions: Marinate fish cubes in lime juice with chili and onions. Serve with boiled sweet potato and corn.

recipes.name: Lomo Saltado
recipes.instructions: Stir-fry beef at high heat. Add onions and tomatoes. Mix with soy sauce, vinegar, and crispy fries.

recipes.name: Aji de Gallina
recipes.instructions: Cook a creamy sauce with chili and bread. Stir in chicken. Serve over boiled potatoes with rice.

recipes.name: Causa Limeña
recipes.instructions: Mash potatoes with lime and chili. Layer potato, avocado, and meat filling like a small cake.

recipes.name: Papa a la Huancaína
recipes.instructions: Blend cheese, chili, milk, and crackers into a smooth sauce. Pour over potato slices.
